title: Check Knight Tour Configuration
summary: Given an n x n grid with distinct integers from 0 to n^2-1, determine if the knight's tour is valid starting from the top-left cell and visiting each cell exactly once.
statement: Given an n x n grid with distinct integers from 0 to n^2-1, determine if the knight's tour is valid starting from the top-left cell and visiting each cell exactly once. Each cell's value represents the order of the knight's visit. Valid knight moves are illustrated.
constraints: The n by n grid contains every visit label from zero through n^2-1 exactly once.
The tour must begin at grid[0][0] with label zero.
Return whether every consecutive label is separated by one knight move.
hints: Invert the grid into a label-to-coordinate array.
Verify label zero is at the top-left.
For every adjacent label pair, compute absolute row and column differences.
A valid knight move has differences (1,2) or (2,1); checking the complete label sequence proves the tour.
editorial: A valid knight move has differences (1,2) or (2,1); checking the complete label sequence proves the tour.

tests.explanation: Every consecutive label follows a knight displacement and zero begins at the top-left.
Labels zero and one are not a knight move apart, so the configuration is invalid.
